summary: Clean, minimal fix that replaces the prop-cycle mutation with local color iteration via itertools.cycle (colors given) or a get_next_color generator (colors None), correctly resolving both the CN-alias ValueError and the 'stackplot should not change Axes cycler' complaint. Behavior matches the old code for color count/cycling while no longer leaking state into the Axes.

issues.description: Behavior of `colors` param subtly changes (no longer mutates the Axes prop cycle); the `colors` docstring could note this, but not merge-blocking.
